chapters.reason: The paper introduces a model that operates on explicit higher-level semantic representations (concepts) in a latent embedding space rather than raw tokens, which is the core contribution.
The model performs autoregressive prediction in a continuous embedding space, effectively replacing token-level reasoning with latent-space operations.
The model uses SONAR embeddings to be modality-agnostic (text and speech), aligning with the goal of processing information at a higher level of abstraction across modalities.
